description: This Python module defines a ReportService class responsible for generating, exporting, and managing validation reports in various formats (JSON, HTML, PDF, Excel). It interacts with models for report data and storage for report persistence, providing methods for exporting reports, generating HTML content for reports, and managing report lifecycle.
